generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential unique integers starting at a fresh offset (e.g. 10001); never NULL; no duplicates; parent primary keys are finalized before any child foreign key is drawn.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Draw from the parent's FINALIZED primary-key pool only (sampled after parent PK assignment); no NULL and no out-of-pool values (child_rows_with_null_fk=false); ~5% of parent rows intentionally have no children.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_numeric: Uniform integer over [min(observed), max(observed)] with NO upper clamp: if observed max exceeds 2**31-1 (e.g. phone_number ~1.4e10) sample in [list_min, max(list_min, observed_max)]; guard randrange so lo<=hi; include listed boundary literals and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.real_numeric: Uniform real within observed min/max; include listed boundary values and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Sample from a realistic pool; allow near-duplicate case variants and ~20-50% duplicate share on DISTINCT columns; >=30% fresh values not present in the original sample.
generic_sampling_rules.text_long: Sample from a pool of realistic sentences; allow case near-variants and ~20-50% duplicate share on DISTINCT columns; >=30% fresh values.
generic_sampling_rules.date_iso: Uniform date in %Y-%m-%d between 2012-01-01 and 2016-12-31; include listed boundary literals and one day on each side; keep stated order rules.
generic_sampling_rules.nullable: Every nullable column gets at least one NULL row and non-NULL rows per instance; NULL share follows the compact database's null_rate; NULL is planted BEFORE duplicates/ties/boundaries and planted positions are excluded from later NULL overwrite; rules constrain only non-NULL operands.
generic_sampling_rules.tie_order: For ORDER/LIMIT columns ensure at least two rows share the rank-1 value in each listed direction; plant ties AFTER NULL rule and PK finalization and freeze them through child sampling.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_values: Use fresh values not present in the original sample for at least 30% of rows per text column.
generic_sampling_rules.post_processing_order: 1) assign final parent PKs; 2) apply range/enum/order rules; 3) draw child FKs from finalized PK pool; 4) apply NULL rule; 5) plant duplicates/ties/boundaries at positions excluded from NULL sampling; 6) verify FK integrity explicitly (foreign_keys pragma enabled).
